question: Two chords in a circle each measure 10 cm. If one of the chords is located 4 cm from the center, what is the distance of the other chord from the center?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

According to the geometric properties of a circle, equal chords are always equidistant from the center.

Since the lengths of both chords are equal (10 cm each), their perpendicular distances from the center will also be exactly equal.

The distance of the first chord from the center is given as 4 cm.

Therefore, the distance of the second chord from the center must also be 4 cm.

**∴ The correct answer is 4 cm.**
